item.title: pgbot: Postgres Intelligence for AI Agents and Apps
item.description: Connect any PostgreSQL database and get visibility into performance, queries, health, schema, and changes — with AI-powered explanations. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Article: Post-Quantum Cryptography in Spring Boot: Four Patterns You Can Ship This Sprint
item.description: There are four patterns that bring PQC into a Spring Boot fleet: encrypting payloads between services, locking down database fields, signing documents that need to hold up for decades, and moving service tokens off RS256. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: How we tunnel a public URL into an untrusted sandbox
item.description: Have you ever thought about how a sandbox tunnels a public URL out to the world when one end of the tunnel is untrusted code owned by the user? Take an example: a localhost:3000 app running in a sandbox inside a VM. (1 source: rprogramming)
